Do we have any signal on how often `ResolveOwner` succeeds across the supported agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, Factory Droid)? The transient list (proclive.go:88-100) is tuned for `entire`/shells/`go`, and the comment there notes interpreter runtimes were deliberately left off because "for several agents the runtime IS the long-lived agent" — which is a judgement call per agent, currently unverified per agent. A one-off count of non-nil `Owner` across real session states would tell us whether these features are load-bearing or decorative on the agents we actually ship for.
